pr_metadata.title: fix(backend): prevent org deletion from setting current_org_id to NULL
pr_metadata.description: ## Summary of PR - Fixes an issue where organization deletion fails due to a NOT NULL constraint violation on `current_org_id`. - Reassigns users to an alternative organization when their current organization is deleted. - Prevents deletion when any user would be left without an organization. **Changes** - `org_store.py`: Replaced NULL assignment with a batch SQL operation to detect orphaned users and reassign `current_org_id` to an alternative organization. - `org_models.py`: Added an `OrphanedUserError` exception to handle cases where deletion would leave users without an organization. - `orgs.py`: Added handling for `OrphanedUserError`, returning an HTTP 400 response. ## Demo Screenshots/Videos ## Change Type - [x] Bug fix - [ ] New feature - [ ] Breaking change - [ ] Refactor - [ ] Other (dependency update, docs, typo fixes, etc.) ## Checklist - [x] I have read and reviewed the code and I understand what the code is doing. - [x] I have tested the code to the best of my ability and ensured it works as expected. ## Fixes Resolves #(issue) ## Release Notes - [ ] Include this change in the Release Notes. --- To run this PR locally, use the following command: GUI with Docker: ``` docker run -it --rm -p 3000:3000 -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock --add-host host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e SANDBOX_RUNTIME_CONTAINER_IMAGE=docker.openhands.dev/openhands/runtime:7bdf978-nikolaik --name openhands-app-7bdf978 docker.openhands.dev/openhands/openhands:7bdf978 ```
